failure_reason: Site total-count for the Pet Accessories PLP is unstable/unverifiable (835 items via WebFetch render vs 854 items via a separate Playwright render minutes later) and the listing is confirmed contaminated with non-pet 'Home' product-type items (e.g. a Staub ceramic baking dish appeared on page 1), so no exact pet-only count can be certified. A follow-up live Playwright session that tried to click the Product Type facet to isolate the 'Pet Care' sub-count was redirected mid-session to https://siteclosed.nordstrom.com/invitation.html (a bot-wall page, noindex/noarchive), so per the first-block rule no further live requests were made to nordstrom.com.
notes: Checked: navigation-sitemap.xml (https://www.nordstrom.com/navigation-sitemap.xml, fetched directly via HTTP, 200 OK, unprotected) for the full /browse/home nav tree - the ONLY pet-relevant node under Home is https://www.nordstrom.com/browse/home/pet-accessories (a single leaf URL, no child URLs in the sitemap). A second pet node exists at /browse/fan-shop/pet-accessories but that's under Fan Shop (sports licensed gear), out of the Home & Pets scope per task instructions, so excluded. Rendered the pet-accessories page twice: WebFetch (renders past the site's ISTL JS interstitial, matching the methodology the prior Home-Decor pass on this company used) reported breadcrumb 'Home > Home > Pet Accessories', total '835 items', and a left-nav Product Type filter with three options: All Home / Pet Care / Pet Clothing (no counts shown next to the options in that render). First-page product titles were mostly genuine pet items (SUNNY TAILS dog harness/collar/leash, Heys Pawsenger pet carrier, maxbone dog raincoat/life jacket, pet beds) but also included 'Staub 3-Piece Ceramic Mixed Baking Dishes' - a non-pet kitchen item - proving the category is not 100% pet-pure. A separate Playwright headless-Chromium render of the same URL a few minutes later showed '854 items' (a different total than the WebFetch render), and a filter-URL guess of ?filterByProductType=pet-care (surfaced by an earlier WebFetch pass, not independently confirmed as a real server-recognized parameter) returned an empty/blank render when re-fetched, so that facet split could not be verified. When Playwright then tried to click the Product Type accordion/checkbox to isolate 'Pet Care' interactively, the session was redirected to https://siteclosed.nordstrom.com/invitation.html - stopped further live requests to the host per the first-block rule. robots.txt (https://www.nordstrom.com/robots.txt, fetched directly, 200 OK) has no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow entries. No other Pet Care categories found anywhere else in the sitemap's /browse/home tree (Bath, Bedding, Kitchen, Dining & Entertainment, Decor, Luggage & Travel, Pantry, Dorm, Electronics, Outdoor, etc. all checked - none pet-specific).

rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: unstable/unverifiable qty - two live renders of the same PLP returned different totals (WebFetch: 'Home > Home > Pet Accessories ... 835 items'; Playwright headless-Chromium render: '854 items' matched via regex '([\d,]+)\s*items' in rendered HTML). The listing also mixes non-pet 'Home' product-type items with genuine pet items (a 'Product Type' filter shows All Home / Pet Care / Pet Clothing facet values, and a Staub ceramic baking dish appeared among the first 10 products), so neither total is a certified pet-only count. Attempted to isolate the 'Pet Care' facet count via a filter query param and via interactive Playwright click; both failed (empty render / redirect to siteclosed.nordstrom.com/invitation.html bot-wall). This is the only Pet Care node found in the site's /browse/home nav tree (per navigation-sitemap.xml) - genuinely present, needs a human to re-verify count and confirm/prune the non-pet contamination.
